notablePrerequisites: Pith Driller does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrifiicing Pith Driller.
When Pith Driller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Pith Driller enters the battlefield, it and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the Pith Driller trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.
